content:
emma: FYI incoming request from ACME. They want a 5x quota increase for prod traffic next week — launch window tight. Account: acct_7221, current limit: 500k tokens/day, requested: 2.5M tokens/day. Primary contact: jessica@acme.com. Urgency: high.

liam: +1. Sales says they're ready to sign a PO, but need product/ops signoff. @maria can you take a look? Support ticket: https://redwood.support/t/58231

emma: quick usage snapshot: last 7d avg 1.1M tokens/day, spike to 3.6M three days ago. No billing alerts flagged. IP ranges look consistent, mostly us-east-1. Paste of recent access lines:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z acct_7221 key=sk_live_xxx ip=3.120.45.12 tokens=12450 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z acct_7221 key=sk_live_xxx ip=3.120.45.12 tokens=13000 route=/v1/chat
```

noah-fraud: automated screening result: FraudScore=12 (low). Device diversity low, geolocation stable, no rapid key rotations detected. Recommend manual review of traffic patterns for 48h and verify corporate billing email. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. Product concerns: we need a safe rollout plan and explicit acceptance criteria. Proposal: staged uplift — canary at 2x for 24h, monitor latency, error-rate, token-per-request distribution. If stable, escalate to 5x. Requirements before canary: signed PO, billing cleared, manual fraud review green, dedicated API key for the canary. Also need a runbook with rollback triggers.

liam: customer says can do canary but launch date is next Tue. Can we make the canary window compressed (12h) and still be comfortable? They need capacity during launch.

maria: shortened canary OK only if monitoring is strict and ops on-call during window. Acceptance criteria: error-rate <0.5%, p95 latency delta <50ms vs baseline, no anomaly in token patterns. If any criteria fail, rollback immediately.

emma: Support can provision a temporary key and watch. Suggested temporary limits: quota 2.0M/day for canary, rate cap 200 r/s. We'll collect logs and metrics to share with product/security. Also will include a revocation command: `support revoke-key acct_7221 canary-key` and rollback playbook.

noah-fraud: add manual checklist: 1) corporate email domain validated, 2) PO matches billing profile, 3) traffic origin IPs check (no sudden global distribution), 4) user-agent variety sanity check. If any item fails, block uplift.

ops-bot: provisioning ticket created INC-2026-042 (reserved burst capacity request). ETA ~3h to reserve capacity and attach to acct_7221. Will post update here when ready.

liam: owners: emma (support) — customer comms & monitoring during canary; maria (product) — acceptance criteria & rollout decision; tony (infra) — capacity provisioning and rate limit config. @tony-infra please confirm.

tony-infra: confirming. I'll set up the quota bucket and a canary policy with automatic throttles. Will add alerting to the product dashboard. ETA 2.5h.

emma: I'll draft a short PRD and runbook and attach to the support ticket. Planning to include exact queries we need to watch and Slack alert hooks.

maria: OK moving this to product backlog as `quota-uplift-acme` P1. Product will own rollout decision after canary. Please tag finance for PO verification and security for the manual fraud review.

liam: customer notified of staged plan and thankful. They're preparing PO now.

emma: will follow up with logs and the canary key once provisioned.

maria: thanks everyone — keep updates concise in this thread. :rocket:
